title: Finneas Marries Claudia Sulewski in Ceremony Officiated by Billie Eilish
summary: The couple tied the knot in California after getting engaged in September 2025.
body: Congratulations are in order for Finneas and his longtime love, Claudia Sulewski, who have officially tied the knot. The Grammy-winning singer and producer, 29, married the YouTuber, actress and CYKLAR Skincare founder, 30, at San Ysidro Ranch in Santa Barbara, California, on Saturday (Aug. 30), according to TMZ . Related Finneas and Longtime Girlfriend Claudia Sulewski Engaged After Seven Years of Dating Finneas to Keynote Guild of Music Supervisors’ 2026 State of Music in Media Conference Billie Eilish’s ‘Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour’ Film Hits Streaming This Week The intimate ceremony was officiated by Finneas’ superstar sister and longtime musical collaborator, Billie Eilish . Their parents, Maggie Baird and Patrick O’Connell, were also there to watch their son exchange vows. The couple celebrated with family, celebrity friends and their dogs, Peaches and Moose. Among the famous guests were Justin and Hailey Bieber, Rachel Sennott, Emma Chamberlain, Rebecca Black, Jason Sudeikis, Kristen Bell, Dax Shepard, Devon Lee Carlson, Stassie Karanikolaou and Jesse Jo Stark. title: I rely on Google Maps every day, but these 4 missing features still hold it back
summary: Google Maps is my go-to travel app, but these missing features drive me crazy.
body: Over the past two decades, Google Maps has evolved from a simple navigation app into a tool I use for almost everything. From my daily commute to helping me find nearby coffee shops and business opening hours, to providing live traffic information so I can figure out when I need to leave for my destination, the feature set has expanded by leaps and bounds. But despite all those updates, redesigns, and AI additions, there are still some features I wish Google Maps had added . None of these features require a ground-up rethink. Instead, these are simple quality-of-life tools that would make Maps more useful for people who rely on it every day.
